use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use POINT = (x: double, y: double)

let steps = 240

around(radius: double) -> List[POINT] =>
    (0..steps + 1)
        |> map(step =>
            (let angle =
                 2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(step) / cast double(steps)

             (x = 150.0D + radius * Math.cos(angle),
              y = 150.0D + radius * Math.sin(angle))))
        |> collect_list()

let image = IMAGE(300, 300)

image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 0ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)

image.line(around(120.0D))
image.line(around(50.0D))

image.colour(230ub, 180ub, 60ub)
image.flood_fill(150, 90)

image.colour(60ub, 120ub, 200ub)
image.flood_fill(150, 150)

image.write("flooded.png")

image.show("flooded.png")
